scanNote:
4-UNITNING UCHINCHI BETI (28-bet).

Yuqorida chapda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '4' va yonida 'Days to Remember'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) 'Replace the adjectives in bold with similar ones from the list.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: huge, exhausted, relieved, tiny, terrified. Ostida Sam haqidagi qisqa matn; qalin harfli so'zlar: frightened, big, small, glad, tired.
10) 'Fill in the correct adverb, then say how we form adverbs.' Ikki ustunda 8 ta sifat va strelka: sudden, loud, final, gentle / pretty, hard, fast, good.
11) 'Fill in the correct adverb from the list, then make sentences using the verb and adverb together.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: brightly, carefully, heavily, loudly, sweetly, violently. Ikki ustunda 6 band. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'It was raining heavily as John was going back home.'
12) 'Fill in the opposites, then make sentences using them.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: fantastic, interesting, difficult, terrible, expensive, short. Ikki ustunda 6 band.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking' sarlavhasi.
13) 'Read the dialogue. Then, act out similar dialogues in pairs using the prompts below.' Chapda och pushti ramkada A va B dialogi (qalin harfli so'zlar bilan); o'ngda to'rtta nuqtali ko'rsatma.

O'NG USTUN:
14) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Match items a - i to the pictures (1 - 9), then listen and tick the sounds you hear. Finally, say which sounds you could hear and which you couldn't, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna: 'I could hear the wind howling. I couldn't hear a tap dripping.' Ostida a - i ro'yxati; 'a' yonida ALLAQAChON '2' yozilgan.
Ostida OQ ramkali CHIZMA RASMLAR jadvali (9 ta), har birida raqamli katakcha:
1 - shamolda egilgan daraxtlar (1-katakchada ✓ belgisi bor)
2 - it, 'WOOF! WOOF!' yozuvi bilan
3 - yomg'irda soyabonli odam
4 - to'xtayotgan qizil mashina, 'EEEE!' yozuvi
5 - katta soat, 'TICK - TOCK!' yozuvi
6 - tez yordam mashinasi, 'DEE-DAH!' yozuvi
7 - tomayotgan jo'mrak
8 - eshikni taqillatayotgan qo'l, 'RAT TAT TAT' yozuvi
9 - dengiz ustidagi chaqmoq
15) 'Use words from the list to say how each person feels:' thrilled, anxious, nervous, sad, puzzled, amazed. Oltita gap; 1-gapga ko'k qiya '...amazed...' javobi berilgan.
16) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and match the speakers to how they feel.' Och pushti jadval: Speaker 1-4 va a thrilled, b puzzled, c sad, d scared.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '28'.

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the adjectives in bold with similar ones from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli sifatlarni ro'yxatdagi yaqin ma'noli sifatlar bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KUChLIROQ SIFATLAR.

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi sifatlar oddiy
  sifatlarning KUChLI shakli:

     frightened → TERRIFIED
        (qo'rqqan → dahshatga tushgan)
     big → HUGE
        (katta → ulkan)
     small → TINY
        (kichik → juda kichkina)
     glad → RELIEVED
        (xursand → yengil tortgan)
     tired → EXHAUSTED
        (charchagan → holdan toygan)


⚠ KUChLI SIFATLAR BILAN 'VERY'
IShLATILMAYDI:

  ✓ very big → ✗ very huge
  ✓ very tired → ✗ very exhausted

  ⚠ Ular o'rniga 'absolutely' yoki
  'completely' ishlatiladi:
     'absolutely huge'
     'completely exhausted'


MATNNING TO'LIQ ShAKLI:

  'Sam heard the fireman knock on the
   window. He was TERRIFIED, but he
   knew he had to get out. The flames
   were HUGE and he was very hot.
   Slowly, he moved towards the window.
   It was TINY and Sam didn't know if
   he could get through. He managed
   after many attempts and when he
   reached the ground he felt very
   RELIEVED. He suddenly realised that
   he was EXHAUSTED. All he wanted to do
   was to sleep.'


⚠ 'TO HEAR SB DO STH':

  'Sam heard the fireman KNOCK on the
   window.'
  ⚠ 'hear' dan keyin 'to' SIZ infinitiv -
  ish TUGAGANINI bildiradi.
  ⚠ 'heard him KNOCKING' - jarayonni
  bildiradi.


⚠ 'TO MANAGE':

  = uddasidan chiqmoq.
  ⚠ 'to manage TO DO sth' - infinitiv
  bilan.
  ⚠ Boshqa ma'nosi: boshqarmoq
  (21-betda 'management').


⚠ 'AN ATTEMPT':

  = urinish.
  ⚠ 'to attempt' = urinmoq.


⚠ 'RELIEVED':

  = yengil tortgan (xavf o'tgach).
  ⚠ 'relief' (ot) = yengillik.
  ⚠ 'What a relief!' = xayriyat!

items.sentence: The flames were big → The flames were ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'huge' - 'big' ning KUChLI shakli.
⚠ 'h' O'QILADI: /hjuːdʒ/.
⚠ 'very huge' - XATO.

items.sentence: He felt very glad → He felt very ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'relieved' = xavf o'tgach yengil tortgan.
⚠ 'relief' (ot) = yengillik.
⚠ 'glad' - shunchaki xursand.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct adverb, then say how we form adverbs.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri ravishni qo'ying, so'ng ravishlar qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
RAVISh YaSASh QOIDALARI.


1) ODDIY: SIFAT + -LY

  sudden → suddenLY
  loud   → loudLY


2) '-LE' BILAN TUGASA: '-LE' → '-LY'

  gentle → gentLY
  terrible → terribLY
  simple → simpLY

  ⚠ 'gentlely' - XATO.


3) '-AL' BILAN TUGASA: + -LY

  final → finalLY (IKKI 'l')
  usual → usualLY
  normal → normalLY

  ⚠ 'finaly' - XATO, ikkita 'l' kerak.


4) UNDOSh + 'Y' → '-ILY'

  pretty → prettILY
  heavy → heavILY
  happy → happILY
  easy → easILY


5) O'ZGARMAYDIGANLAR:

  hard → hard
  fast → fast
  late → late
  early → early
  straight → straight

  ⚠ 'fastly' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin 'deyarli
  emas' ma'nosida - BOShQA so'z.


6) QOIDASIZ:

  good → WELL

  ⚠ 'goodly' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'well' yana SIFAT ham bo'ladi:
  'I'm well' = sog'lomman.


⚠ 'PRETTILY' - KAM IShLATILADI:

  ⚠ 'pretty' ko'proq RAVISh sifatida
  ishlatiladi va 'ancha' ma'nosini
  beradi: 'pretty good' = ancha yaxshi.

items.whyUz:
⚠ ODDIY qoida: sifat + -LY.
⚠ 27-betdagi hikoyada ham bor edi.

⚠ UNDOSh + Y → -ILY.
⚠ 'pretty' ko'proq RAVISh sifatida ishlatiladi:
'pretty good' = ancha yaxshi.

⚠ O'ZGARMAYDI!
⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin 'deyarli emas'
ma'nosida - BUTUNLAY boshqa so'z.

⚠ QOIDASIZ shakl.
⚠ 'goodly' - XATO.
⚠ 'well' SIFAT ham bo'ladi: 'I'm well' = sog'lomman.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct adverb from the list, then make sentences using the verb and adverb together.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri ravishni qo'ying, so'ng fe'l va ravishni birga ishlatib gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
FE'L + RAVISh BIRIKMASI.

  ⚠ Bu ham COLLOCATION: qaysi ravish
  qaysi fe'l bilan yuradi.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'It was RAINING HEAVILY as John was
   going back home.'


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to rain HEAVILY   - qattiq yomg'ir
                      yog'moq
  to sing SWEETLY   - shirin kuylamoq
  to shine BRIGHTLY - yorqin porlamoq
  to climb CAREFULLY - ehtiyotkorlik
                      bilan chiqmoq
  to shout LOUDLY   - baland ovozda
                      qichqirmoq
  to shake VIOLENTLY - qattiq silkinmoq


⚠ 'HEAVILY' - YoMG'IR UChUN:

  ⚠ 'to rain heavily' ✓
  ⚠ 'to rain strongly' ✗

  ⚠ 27-betdagi hikoyada ham:
  'It was raining HEAVILY outside.'


⚠ 'VIOLENTLY':

  = qattiq, shiddat bilan.
  ⚠ 'violence' (ot) = zo'ravonlik.
  ⚠ 'to shake violently' = qattiq
  silkinmoq (zilzila, qo'rquv).


⚠ 'BRIGHTLY':

  = yorqin.
  ⚠ 'bright' - 16-betdagi maqolada
  'iqtidorli' ma'nosida edi:
  'this bright young star'.


⚠ 'CAREFULLY':

  ⚠ Imlosi: 'care' + 'full' → 'careful'
  (BITTA 'l') → 'carefully' (IKKI 'l').


⚠ RAVISh GAPDA QAYERDA TURADI:

  Odatda FE'LDAN KEYIN:
     'It was raining HEAVILY.'
     'She sang SWEETLY.'

  ⚠ To'ldiruvchi bo'lsa - undan KEYIN:
     'He opened the door SLOWLY.'
     ('opened slowly the door' XATO)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the opposites, then make sentences using them.
exercises.instructionUz: Qarama-qarshi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
QARAMA-QARShI SIFATLAR.

  good ≠ TERRIBLE
  cheap ≠ EXPENSIVE
  easy ≠ DIFFICULT
  boring ≠ INTERESTING
  long ≠ SHORT
  awful ≠ FANTASTIC


⚠ 'GOOD' NING BIR NEChA AKSI:

  good ≠ bad (oddiy)
  good ≠ terrible (kuchli)
  good ≠ awful (kuchli)

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda 'terrible' berilgan,
  chunki 'awful' 6-bandda ishlatilgan.


⚠ 'AWFUL' va 'FANTASTIC':

  awful = dahshatli, juda yomon
  fantastic = ajoyib, juda yaxshi

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham KUChLI sifat.
  ⚠ 'awful' - 'awe' (hurmat aralash
  qo'rquv) so'zidan; hozir faqat
  salbiy ma'noda.


⚠ 'BORING' va 'INTERESTING':

  ⚠ IKKALASI ham -ING bilan tugaydi -
  bular NARSANI tasvirlaydi.
  ⚠ Odam haqida -ED shakli:
     'The film is BORING.' (film
        zerikarli)
     'I am BORED.' (men zerikdim)

  ⚠ Bu farq juda ko'p xato qilinadi.


⚠ 'EXPENSIVE' va 'CHEAP':

  ⚠ 22-betdagi 22-mashqda 'cheaper'
  va 'more expensive' bor edi.


⚠ 13-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  Bu sifatlar 13-mashqdagi dialogda
  ishlatiladi: fantastic/boring,
  cheap, awful/difficult,
  boring/good, long/interesting.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue. Then, act out similar dialogues in pairs using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing. So'ng juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TA'SSUROT SO'RASh VA AYTISh.

KITOBDAGI DIALOG:
  A: How was your holiday?
  B: It was fantastic/boring.
  A: Was the weather good?
  B: Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
     It was awful.


⚠ 'HOW WAS ...?':

  = ... qanday o'tdi?
  ⚠ Bu - tajriba haqida so'rashning
  eng oddiy qolipi.
  ⚠ 'What was it like?' ham to'g'ri.


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  'Was the weather good?'
     - 'Yes, it WAS.' / "No, it WASN'T."

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L
  takrorlanadi.
  ⚠ Tasdiqda QISQARTMA IShLATILMAYDI:
  "Yes, it's" - XATO.


KO'RSATMALAR (yangi dialoglar uchun):

  • the concert/fantastic -
    the tickets/cheap?
  • your Maths exam/awful -
    the questions/difficult?
  • the play/boring -
    the actors/good?
  • the lecture/long -
    the lecturer/interesting?

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada IKKI qism:
     1) umumiy taassurot
     2) tafsilot haqida savol


⚠ SIFATLAR 12-MAShQDAN:

  fantastic, boring, awful, difficult,
  good, long, interesting, cheap -
  hammasi 12-mashqda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'A LECTURE' va 'A LECTURER':

  a lecture = ma'ruza (16-betdagi
     dialogda ham bor edi)
  a lecturer = ma'ruzachi, o'qituvchi
     (universitetda)

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'How was ...?' - tajriba haqida so'rashning
asosiy qolipi.
⚠ 'holiday' - Britaniyada ta'til; AQShda
'vacation'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It was fantastic. / It was boring.

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Tafsilot haqida savol.
⚠ 'weather' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot, artiklsiz
('THE weather' - ma'lum ob-havo).

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't. It was awful.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L takrorlanadi.
⚠ Tasdiqda qisqartma IShLATILMAYDI.
⚠ 'awful' - 12-mashqda 'fantastic' ning aksi.

exercises.instructionEn: Act out similar dialogues in pairs using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT YANGI DIALOG.

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada: MAVZU/SIFAT -
  TAFSILOT/SIFAT?

  ⚠ 12-mashqdagi qarama-qarshi
  sifatlardan foydalanib javobni
  o'zgartiring.

points.en: A: How was the concert? B: It was fantastic. A: Were the tickets cheap? B: No, they weren't. They were very expensive.
points.uz: A: Konsert qanday o'tdi? B: Ajoyib. A: Chiptalar arzon edimi? B: Yo'q. Juda qimmat edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'tickets' - KO'PLIK, shuning uchun
"Were ...?" va "they weren't".
⚠ 'cheap ≠ expensive' - 12-mashqdan.

points.en: A: How was your Maths exam? B: It was awful. A: Were the questions difficult? B: Yes, they were.
points.uz: A: Matematika imtihoning qanday o'tdi? B: Dahshat edi. A: Savollar qiyin edimi? B: Ha.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Maths' - fan nomi, KATTA harf, artiklsiz.
⚠ 'easy ≠ difficult' - 12-mashqdan.

points.en: A: How was the play? B: It was boring. A: Were the actors good? B: No, they weren't. They were terrible.
points.uz: A: Spektakl qanday o'tdi? B: Zerikarli. A: Aktyorlar yaxshi edimi? B: Yo'q. Dahshat edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a play' = spektakl (13-betdagi 8-mashqda
ham bor edi).
⚠ 'good ≠ terrible' - 12-mashqdan.

points.en: A: How was the lecture? B: It was long. A: Was the lecturer interesting? B: Yes, he was.
points.uz: A: Ma'ruza qanday o'tdi? B: Uzun edi. A: Ma'ruzachi qiziqarli edimi? B: Ha.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a lecture' = ma'ruza; 'a lecturer' =
ma'ruzachi.
⚠ 'long ≠ short', 'boring ≠ interesting' -
12-mashqdan.

exercises.instructionEn: Match items a - i to the pictures (1 - 9), then listen and tick the sounds you hear. Finally, say which sounds you could hear and which you couldn't, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: a - i bandlarni rasmlarga (1 - 9) moslang, so'ng tinglang va eshitgan tovushlaringizni belgilang. Nihoyat, qaysi tovushlarni eshitgan va qaysilarini eshitmaganingizni ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOVUSh FE'LLARI.

  ⚠ Har fe'l ANIQ bir tovushni
  bildiradi - o'zbekchada bunday
  aniqlik yo'q.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  a  a dog BARKING - it hurishi (2)
  b  a clock TICKING - soat chiqillashi (5)
  c  a tap DRIPPING - jo'mrak tomishi (7)
  d  a siren WAILING - sirena uvillashi (6)
  e  rain FALLING - yomg'ir yog'ishi (3)
  f  the wind HOWLING - shamol uvillashi (1)
  g  someone KNOCKING on the door -
     eshik taqillashi (8)
  h  thunder RUMBLING - momaqaldiroq
     gumburlashi (9)
  i  car brakes SCREECHING - tormoz
     chiyillashi (4)

  ⚠ Kitobda 'a' bandiga ALLAQAChON
  '2' yozilgan (namuna).


⚠ RASMDAGI TOVUSh YoZUVLARI:

  'WOOF! WOOF!' - it (2)
  'EEEE!' - tormoz (4)
  'TICK - TOCK!' - soat (5)
  'DEE-DAH!' - tez yordam sirenasi (6)
  'RAT TAT TAT' - eshik taqillashi (8)

  ⚠ Bu - 'onomatopoeia' (tovush
  taqlidi). Har tilda boshqacha:
  it inglizchada 'woof', o'zbekchada
  'vov'.


⚠ 'COULD' va 'COULDN'T':

  NAMUNA:
     'I COULD hear the wind howling.'
     "I COULDN'T hear a tap dripping."

  ⚠ 'could' - o'tmishdagi qobiliyat
  yoki imkoniyat.
  ⚠ 'hear', 'see', 'smell' fe'llari
  bilan odatda 'can/could' ishlatiladi:
  'I can hear a noise' ('I hear'
  o'rniga).


⚠ 'HEAR' + -ING:

  'I could hear the wind HOWLING.'
  ⚠ -ING shakli DAVOM ETAYoTGAN
  tovushni bildiradi.


⚠ 'A TAP':

  Britaniyada 'a tap', AQShda
  'a faucet' = jo'mrak.


⚠ 'BRAKES':

  = tormoz. HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
  ⚠ 'to brake' (tormoz bosmoq) va
  'to break' (sindirmoq) - talaffuzi
  BIR XIL, imlosi boshqa!

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN (namuna).
⚠ 'to bark' = hurmoq.
⚠ 'WOOF' - inglizcha it tovushi.

⚠ 'to tick' = chiqillamoq.
⚠ 27-betdagi hikoyada ham 'a clock ticking'
bor edi.

⚠ 'to drip' = tomchilab oqmoq.
⚠ 'a tap' - Britaniya; AQShda 'a faucet'.

⚠ 'to wail' = uvillamoq, nola qilmoq.
⚠ 'DEE-DAH' - Britaniya tez yordam sirenasi
tovushi.

⚠ 'to fall' - noto'g'ri fe'l: fall - fell -
fallen.
⚠ 'rain' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot, artiklsiz.

⚠ 'to howl' = uvillamoq (shamol, bo'ri).
⚠ Namunada shu tovush eshitilgan:
'I COULD hear the wind howling.'

pairs.left: g  someone knocking on the door
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'to knock ON the door' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 28-betdagi 9-mashqda ham: 'heard the fireman
KNOCK on the window'.

⚠ 'to screech' = chiyillamoq.
⚠ 'brakes' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'to brake' va 'to break' - talaffuzi BIR XIL.

exercises.instructionEn: Use words from the list to say how each person feels.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan har bir odam o'zini qanday his qilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIS-TUYG'U SIFATLARI.

  thrilled - hayajonli xursand
  anxious  - xavotirda
  nervous  - asabiy, hadiksirab
  sad      - g'amgin
  puzzled  - hayron
  amazed   - hayratda


⚠ 'AMAZED' va 'PUZZLED' FARQI:

  amazed = hayratda (yaxshi narsadan)
     'The view is fantastic!' → amazed
  puzzled = hayron (tushunmaganidan)
     'Who on earth can he be?' → puzzled

  ⚠ 27-betdagi hikoyada IKKALASI ham
  bor edi: Janice 'PUZZLED by the
  mysterious disappearance' va
  'GASPED IN AMAZEMENT'.


⚠ 'ANXIOUS' va 'NERVOUS':

  anxious = xavotirda (bir narsa
     bo'lishidan qo'rqadi)
     "It's already 8:20. I must hurry!"
  nervous = asabiy, o'zini noqulay his
     qiladi
     'That woman keeps looking at me.'

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'xavotir' ma'nosida,
  lekin 'anxious' KELAJAKDAGI voqeadan,
  'nervous' HOZIRGI holatdan.


⚠ 'THRILLED':

  = juda xursand, hayajonlangan.
  ⚠ 'a thriller' - shu so'zdan (hayajonli
  film yoki kitob).


⚠ 'WHO ON EARTH ...?':

  = kim ekan-a?
  ⚠ 'on earth' savolni KUChAYTIRADI
  (hayrat yoki g'azab bildiradi).
  ⚠ Yana: 'What on earth are you doing?'


⚠ '-ED' SIFATLARI - ODAM HAQIDA:

  thrilled, puzzled, amazed - hammasi
  -ED bilan tugaydi va ODAMNING
  his-tuyg'usini bildiradi.

  ⚠ -ING shakli esa NARSANI tasvirlaydi:
     'The news is amazING.'
     'I am amazED.'

items.sentence: "Oh! The view from here is fantastic!" - He feels ___ .
items.uz: "Voy! Bu yerdan manzara ajoyib!" - u hayratda.

items.sentence: "Who on earth can he be?" - He feels ___ .
items.uz: "U kim bo'lishi mumkin ekan-a?" - u hayron.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'puzzled' = tushunmaganidan hayron.
⚠ 'on earth' savolni kuchaytiradi.
⚠ 27-betdagi hikoyada Janice ham 'puzzled' edi.

items.sentence: "This is the best party I've ever had!" - He feels ___ .
items.uz: "Bu men ko'rgan eng zo'r bazm!" - u juda xursand.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'thrilled' = hayajonli xursand.
⚠ "the best ... I've EVER had" - PRESENT
PERFECT + 'ever'.

items.sentence: "It's already 8:20. I must hurry!" - He feels ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'anxious' = kelajakdagi voqeadan xavotirda.
⚠ 'already' = allaqachon.
⚠ 'must hurry' - shoshilinch majburiyat.

items.sentence: "That woman over there keeps looking at me. What does she want?" - He feels ___ .
items.uz: "Anavi ayol menga qarayverapti. Nima kerak unga?" - u o'zini noqulay his qilmoqda.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'nervous' = hozirgi holatdan noqulaylik.
⚠ 'to keep DOING sth' = qilishda davom etmoq.

items.sentence: "I'm so sorry about your father." - He feels ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'sad' = g'amgin.
⚠ "I'm sorry ABOUT sth" - hamdardlik bildirish.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Qaysi so'zlovchi o'zini qanday his qilishi FAQAT audioda aytiladi.
exercises.instructionEn: Listen and match the speakers to how they feel.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va so'zlovchilarni ularning his-tuyg'usiga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SO'ZLOVChI, TO'RT HIS-TUYG'U.

  * ⚠ Speaker 1 qanday his qiladi - audiodan
  * ⚠ Speaker 2 qanday his qiladi - audiodan
  * ⚠ Speaker 3 qanday his qiladi - audiodan
  * ⚠ Speaker 4 qanday his qiladi - audiodan


HIS-TUYG'ULAR:

  a  thrilled - hayajonli xursand
  b  puzzled  - hayron
  c  sad      - g'amgin
  d  scared   - qo'rqqan

  ⚠ 'scared' - 15-mashqdagi ro'yxatda
  YO'Q edi; bu YANGI so'z.
  ⚠ 'scared' = qo'rqqan ('frightened'
  bilan bir xil; kuchli shakli
  'terrified' - 9-mashqda).


⚠ TINGLAShGA TAYYoRGARLIK:

  Har his-tuyg'uning KALIT so'zlarini
  o'ylab qo'ying:

  thrilled - 'That's wonderful!',
     'I can't believe it!', kulgi
  puzzled - "I don't understand",
     'Why?', 'How strange'
  sad - 'I'm so sorry', 'It's terrible',
     yig'i
  scared - 'Help!', 'What was that?',
     titroq ovoz

  ⚠ Shunda birinchi kalit so'z
  eshitilishi bilan javob topiladi.


⚠ OVOZ OHANGI HAM YoRDAM BERADI:

  Tinglashda faqat SO'ZLAR emas,
  OHANG ham muhim: baland va tez -
  hayajon; sekin va past - g'am.

patterns.exampleEn: It was raining heavily as John was going back home.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon uyga qaytayotganda qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ RAVISh fe'ldan KEYIN turadi.
⚠ 'as' = ... paytda (ikki uzun ish bir vaqtda).

patterns.exampleEn: How was your holiday? - It was fantastic.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tajriba haqida so'rashning asosiy qolipi.
⚠ 'What was it like?' ham to'g'ri.

patterns.formula: Was/Were [nima] [sifat]? - Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Was the weather good? - No, it wasn't. It was awful.
patterns.exampleUz: Ob-havo yaxshi edimi? - Yo'q. Dahshat edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L takrorlanadi.
⚠ Tasdiqda qisqartma IShLATILMAYDI.

patterns.formula: I could hear [nima] [fe'l]-ing. / I couldn't hear [nima].
patterns.exampleEn: I could hear the wind howling. I couldn't hear a tap dripping.
patterns.exampleUz: Shamolning uvillashini eshitdim. Jo'mrakning tomishini eshitmadim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'hear' fe'li bilan odatda 'can/could'
ishlatiladi.
⚠ Keyin -ING shakli davom etayotgan tovushni
bildiradi.

patterns.exampleEn: "The view is fantastic!" - He feels amazed.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'feel' - HIS fe'li, keyin SIFAT keladi
('feel badly' XATO).
⚠ -ED sifatlari ODAM haqida.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ TOVUSh FE'LLARI - HAR BIRI O'Z NARSASI BILAN
